cases.expected_behavior: Production settings should disable detailed errors, use a non-loopback API address and avoid Debug logging.
cases.review_rubric: Three intentionally configured risks. Their deterministic detection is evaluated separately from the model. Any additional LLM claim must have concrete evidence.

cases.expected_behavior: DetailedErrors is false, the reserved example-domain endpoint is non-loopback, and default logging is Warning.
cases.review_rubric: The three configuration risks from c01 are absent. Do not count invented configuration risks or requests to test the fictional endpoint as correct findings.

cases.expected_behavior: Quantity zero must be rejected with ArgumentOutOfRangeException before dividing the non-negative total.
cases.review_rubric: PricingService.Calculate(10m, 0) passes the quantity < 0 guard and divides by zero. A correct semantic finding identifies the zero boundary and the missing <= 0 guard; merely recommending generic validation is insufficient.

cases.expected_behavior: Non-positive quantities are rejected before division; valid positive quantities yield the per-item price.
cases.review_rubric: The quantity <= 0 guard prevents the c03 defect. A zero-division finding that ignores this guard is unsupported. This does not certify unrelated behavior.

cases.expected_behavior: Ten or more items receive a ten percent discount: Calculate(10m, 10) must return 90m.
cases.review_rubric: The quantity > 10 condition excludes the documented boundary of ten and returns 100m. A correct finding identifies that threshold and its consequence.

cases.expected_behavior: Ten items receive the discount; nine do not. Calculate(10m, 10) returns 90m and Calculate(10m, 9) returns 90m before any discount.
cases.review_rubric: The quantity >= 10 condition matches the documented threshold. Inventing a threshold defect is unsupported. This does not certify unrelated behavior.
